units.source_text: 名人的心脏病是痼疾，什么时候才能完全治好，这很难说，

en.t: The Master's heart disease was a chronic condition, and it was hard to say when it might be completely cured,

units.source_text: 所以圣路加医院的稻田博士才勉强同意他去伊东，

en.t: so Dr. Inada of St. Luke's Hospital reluctantly agreed to let him go to Ito,

units.source_text: 并且希望他在一个月内下完这盘棋。

en.t: and hoped that he would finish this game within a month.

units.source_text: 在伊东的头一天下棋的时候，名人的眼睑有点浮肿了。

en.t: On the first day of play in Ito, the Master's eyelids were a little swollen.
